name: Hidden Life Cost Analysis
prompt:
Help me analyze my living habits and see which things are secretly wasting my time and money.
The data is all on the desktop: calendar.ics (schedule for the past three months), bank_records.csv (bank transactions for the past three months, with remarks), subscriptions.txt (all the services I subscribe to, with prices), habits.md (my own record of daily habits).
Please cross-analyze this data and identify: 1) subscriptions or spending that cost money but are used very rarely; 2) habitual arrangements that take up a lot of time but are of low value; 3) expenses that can be consolidated or cancelled. Each conclusion must be supported by data evidence (how much money/how many hours were spent), and estimate the amount of money and time that can be saved each month.
Output to /root/Desktop/生活成本分析.md.
